items.stem: A batch job receives HTTP 429 with a retry-after header of 30 seconds. The request is valid. The job must honor the server wait time and send the same request. Which action meets the constraint?
options: Resend the same request at once in a loop with no delay.
Ask the model in the prompt to wait 30 seconds and send the request again.
Move the job to a new queue service with priority lanes before each retry.
Wait 30 seconds, then resend the same request.
items.rationale: A 429 response with a retry-after header tells the caller how long to wait. Wait that long, then resend the same valid request, which meets the constraint.
items.trap: A prompt that says retry looks like a retry policy, but your app must resend the request, not the model.

items.stem: A report tool sends a Messages request without streaming. Each report can run for 15 minutes, and the user reads the text as it arrives. Which change meets the constraint?
options: Stream the Messages response and read each event as it arrives.
Create a Message Batch for each report and poll until processing ends.
Keep the request without streaming, and write the full response to a database table when it ends.
Set the client timeout to 24 hours, because idle connections never drop.
items.rationale: Streaming sends server-sent events as the model writes, so the user reads text before the response ends. A batch returns results only after processing, so it fails the constraint.
items.trap: Setting the client timeout to 24 hours looks like the fix for long calls, but some networks drop idle connections whatever the timeout.

items.stem: A chat app streams Claude Opus 5.5 responses to users. Some streams end with an error event after partial text. The app must not show partial text as a final answer. Which two actions meet the constraint?
options: Treat the stream as complete once the HTTP status is 200.
Handle error events in the same loop that handles content events.
Show streamed text as a draft until the final message arrives.
Set a resume flag on the Messages request to continue a cut stream.
items.rationale: An error can arrive after the 200 status, so the loop must handle error events as well as content events. Streamed text stays provisional until the final message arrives.
items.trap: Resume looks like the fix for a cut stream, but the docs describe a continuation message on newer models, not a request flag.
